module rtlpp_01352 (
    address,
    chipselect,
    clk,
    reset_n,
    write_n,
    writedata,
    out_port,
    readdata
);

  output reg out_port;
  output [31:0] readdata;
  input [1:0] address;
  input chipselect;
  input clk;
  input reset_n;
  input write_n;
  input [31:0] writedata;

  reg data_out;

  always @(posedge clk or negedge reset_n) begin
    if (!reset_n)
      data_out <= 0;
    else if (chipselect && ~write_n && (address == 0))
      data_out <= writedata[0];  // Assigning only the LSB as data_out is 1-bit wide
  end

  assign readdata = {31'b0, data_out};
  assign out_port = data_out;

endmodule
